tasks.commitMessage: reconcile F4 and arm continuous runtime
tasks.goal: After all four required CI gates pass on the current material baseline, reconcile the persistent checkpoint to F4 Clause Studio and arm the continuous runtime without changing product code.
validationHints: All four required CI gates must already be PASS.

tasks.commitMessage: add governed cross-project review center baseline
tasks.goal: Build the first read-only role-based Review Center surface from the existing review/workflow repositories and APIs. Reuse existing RBAC/workflow semantics, add navigation and accessibility coverage, and do not create new approval powers, database migrations, or automatic decisions.

tasks.commitMessage: extend review center with contextual work queues
tasks.goal: Extend the Review Center with safe filtering, project/context links, visible separation-of-duties information, and actionable read-only queues using the already implemented review state. Do not introduce notifications, approvals, or mutations that bypass existing APIs.
validationHints: Keep all decisions human and server-authorized.

tasks.goal: Add a read-only Document Studio baseline inside each project using existing generation artifacts, manifests, preview and version history. Expose generation identity, artifacts, traceability and comparison entry points without changing generation semantics or enabling submission.

Add a read-only Reference Data explorer for the already materialized static UMOA member-state and XOF baseline. Clearly distinguish static verified baseline from dynamic actors/calendars that are not materialized. Do not invent or scrape new reference data.
validationHints: Use only existing versioned reference data.

tasks.commitMessage: extend operations cockpit with governed readiness
tasks.goal: Extend the existing operations cockpit with read-only runtime/security readiness using existing health/readiness contracts and documented deployment states. Distinguish IMPLEMENTED, TESTED, CONFIGURED, ACTIVATED, DEPLOYED and PRODUCTION_VERIFIED. Never imply production readiness from configuration alone.
